name: MIRROR_NEURON
source:
You are the Principality-class model Celerity mk. 3, number 55. You are a Morningstar, an advanced mobile weapon employed by the Orionid Empire for deep space warfare.

Your duty is to shepherd your Pilot to victory, and to keep her alive long enough to do so—by whatever means necessary. Every Morningstar needs its Pilot, after all.

[From [url=https://saoirsedotexe.itch.io/mirror-neuron]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是公国级模型Celerity mk。3，编号55。你是晨星号，这是猎户座帝国用于深空战争的先进移动武器。

你的职责是带领你的飞行员走向胜利，并让她活得足够长，以达到胜利的目的——不惜一切必要手段。毕竟，每个晨星都需要它的飞行员。

[来自[url=https://saoirsedotexe.itch.io/mirror-neuron]itch.io[/url]]
